knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says never to assume tape or a sign alone is adequate, to map people moving below, and to withhold commencement until the controller approves public protection.
The lesson says to map people moving underneath and beside a work area, and never to assume tape or a sign alone proves adequate protection.

practicalCriteria: Checks authority and risk hierarchy for Public protection and falling objects
Identifies stop-work trigger in the documented lesson case
Refers specialist work to qualified owner and protects affected people
Records precise mock evidence, open decisions and restricted handover
passRule: All criteria demonstrated and zero critical failures; a numerical mark alone cannot create competence
evidenceRequired: Record verified and unknown site facts distinctly.
Identify safe alternatives, exclusions and conditions requiring work suspension.
Communicate the decision and approval requirements to the site controller.
stopWorkCriteria: Recommends unapproved access or work at height
Assumes site permission, equipment clearance or competence without checking it
Omits protection of bystanders or necessary specialist escalation
Claims safety, compliance or certification without authority
